authority: Static representation policy only; manpower, formation, ownership and appointment truth remain in native owners.

automatic_full_character.rule: Every persistent 500-person or larger command billet is held by a full exact named character. A 100-person command may remain aggregate by default. Representation changes never create manpower.

automatic_person_lite.rule: Person-lite remains available for individually relevant conserved people who do not hold a persistent 500+ command. Persistent 500+ commanders use full exact character sheets.
automatic_person_lite.storage: Person-lite records are routed roster shards and never a population authority.

training_rule: A registered formation or institutional training regimen may delegate role-aware adaptive development to its troops and officer chain. The runtime chooses weak useful, promotion-relevant, loadout-relevant and command/logistics focuses from saved state; the player does not need to micromanage every subordinate focus, and no training time is created by delegation.
external_command_rule: An army or persistent Unit has one top commander outside fighting-strength troop numbers. That person must be conserved from an exact owning or lawfully attached force. Staff and succession are separate authorities and create no extra bodies.
loadout_rule: Representation type never determines equipment. Explicit lawful personal equipment wins. Otherwise use a registered institutional/command-role officer profile compatible with the physical force being commanded; homogeneous local commands may derive a role-appropriate officer issue, while composite commands use an institutional command profile.
materialization_rule: Every internal person-lite consumes one conserved fighting body. Promoting an already-materialized officer representation never creates an additional body. Representation never creates manpower.
capability_rule: Officer capability must fit billet scale and actual equipment. Command, leadership, tactics, logistics and strategy scale with responsibility. Weapon and riding skills matter only where the saved personal issue and current duties require them; holding command never grants unrelated combat skills.
rank_billet_rule: Earned military rank/grade, current billet, and current commanded headcount are separate facts. Casualties never silently promote or demote rank. Reorganization may move a surviving officer between active billet and cadre reserve while preserving rank and history.
aggregate_cadre_rule: Aggregate officers have no individual sheets. Each formation stores compact rank inventory, active billets, cadre reserve, vacancies, and aggregate promotion history. Surplus veteran officers remain attached to the unit for later evaluation/reassignment/rebuilding.
